Olivia (devex): Heads-up: we're planning to deprecate the internal `X-Internal-Route` header in the internal routing API on May 12 (next month). This is used by our SDKs (py/ts/go) as a lightweight route hint. Need to discuss migration strategy and SDK compatibility
Sam (eng-platform): Oof. Which SDK surface requires changes? is this pure header rename or behavioral?
Olivia (devex): It's both. We want to collapse the old header into a unified `Route-Intent` contract and remove the legacy header. Some customers and multiple SDK versions still send `X-Internal-Route` implicitly. If we remove it abruptly, clients will lose affinity/routing for canaries and quota attribution.
Maya (devex): Proposal idea: add a temporary translation shim in the service that accepts `X-Internal-Route` and maps to `Route-Intent`, with an opt-out/timeout and deprecation warning in logs. Then have SDKs emit a deprecation warning at client startup if they detect the old header.
Jin (eng-runtime): Translation shim buys time but also masks mismatches in telemetry. We need to tag translated requests so console attribution and quota buckets can still be reconciled. Maybe add `X-Translated-From: X-Internal-Route` so downstream telemetry knows it was shimmed.
Ryan (eng): For SDKs: Python and TS can probably add a boolean flag `legacy_route_shim=true` (default on for 2 cycles) and emit a structured log line when used. Go SDK is trickier because a lot of teams vendor it; bump may be breaking depending on the API change.
Anna (docs): We'll need clear migration docs and a console-side dashboard showing how many requests still come with `X-Internal-Route` over time. Can we expose a migration metric?
Olivia (devex): Yes — plan: instrument server to emit `migration.route_header.legacy_count` + `migration.route_header.translated_count` with route labels. Console team can surface a chart and recommend owners to update SDK versions.
Sam (eng-platform): Also need a rollout plan for the shim removal: 1) soft-translate + metric collection (2 weeks), 2) SDK minor releases with warning (2 weeks), 3) canary enforcement in a small region (1 week), 4) global enforcement (remove shim) — total ~6 weeks. Thoughts?
Maya (devex): timeline sounds fine. Add a beta flag: `route-header-enforcement` in console so customers can opt-in early.
Jin (eng-runtime): Telemetry note: translated requests must preserve quota attribution keys (tenant_id, cost_center). If we tag them, we can backfill attribution mapping. But we need to ensure KV caches that key off route hash remain stable. Runtime teams: please run the route-hash stability test if using translation.
Ryan (eng): SDK release plan: Python: 0.13.0 (non-breaking, adds opt-in param + warning), TS: 2.5.0 similar, Go: if we keep opt-in as a config param rather than an API type change we can avoid breaking bump. Recommend not to change exported function signatures.
Olivia (devex): Example deprecation log snippet for SDKs: ```
[WARN] Redwood SDK v0.13.0: detected legacy routing header `X-Internal-Route`. This header will be removed on 2026-05-12. Set `legacy_route_shim=false` to opt-out of client-side translation. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/migrations/route-header for details.
```
Maya (devex): UX: console should show a migration panel per tenant with recommended SDK versions and a one-click toggle to 'Enable enforcement' when owners are ready. Also include a list of top apps by legacy-requests.
Anna (docs): I'll draft the migration page and code snippets for py/ts/go. Need sample code for toggling flag in each SDK.
Sam (eng-platform): CI/QA: let's add an integration test that simulates old header + shim and asserts the translated header appears and metric increments. Also add a telemetry reconciliation job for the console to reconcile pre/post counts.
ci-bot: build passed for feat/route-header-shim (PR #4321) :white_check_mark:
Jin (eng-runtime): One more runtime concern: if we translate header values we must guarantee value normalization (trim, lowercase) to prevent spurious splits in route buckets. Add helper `normalize_route_intent()` in runtime library.
Ryan (eng): For the Go SDK, I'll work with teams that vendor to ensure the minor release propagates. If some teams can't upgrade, we might hold enforcement on a per-tenant basis via console flag.
Olivia (devex): Action items: Sam - add migration metrics + shim tag; Jin - implement normalization + tests; Ryan - coordinate Go compatibility and release notes; Maya - console migration panel mock; Anna - docs + snippets; me - messaging and timeline. Please ack and add if I missed anything.
Sam (eng-platform): ack. I'll open the infra ticket and link PRs.
Maya (devex): ack from UX side. I'll drop designs w/copy in #product-ux later.
Jin (eng-runtime): ack. I'll push route-hash stability tests to CI.
Ryan (eng): ack. I'll coordinate the Go compatibility matrix in the release plan doc.
Anna (docs): ack. Will draft the migration doc and link to SDK PRs.
Olivia (devex): Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll schedule the soft-translate rollout for next Monday and ping the customer success leads to prep migration emails. :thumbsup:
